designAnswers.engineCanImportWithoutOutsideEdit: Yes. The engine computes the deploy hex and facing only in src/utils/gameplay/gameState/lifecycle.ts:29-37, inside the owned path src/utils/gameplay/gameState; src/engine reaches it through createGameSession and deriveState and has no placement code of its own (grep of src/engine, src/lib and src/utils/gameplay for the rule found only lifecycle.ts). Switching lifecycle.ts to the exported function needs no edit under src/engine, src/lib or src/components. Not BLOCKED.
designAnswers.gameCreatedOnTheWire: IGameCreatedPayload (GameSessionLifecycleEvents.ts:56-60) carries units: readonly IGameUnit[], each with side; it carries no position, facing or per-side index. Both the engine (lifecycle.ts:26-31) and the projection must derive the per-side index from the order of payload.units. The fog filter keeps every unit and its order in GameCreated (src/lib/multiplayer/server/fogOfWar.ts:123-137 only strips a non-owned customUnitDefinition) and the wire audience catalogue marks GameCreated PUBLIC (src/lib/multiplayer/server/projection/MatchWireAudienceCatalog.ts:73), so every viewer derives the same indices.

designAnswers.firstMovementDeclaredToday: The engine validates and records each move from its own state (the deploy hex), so a networked match's first MovementDeclared carries from = the deploy hex while the projection jumps the token from {0,0} to payload.to. The fix changes only what is displayed before a unit's first MovementDeclared (and at cursor or rewind positions before it); the move path comes from the event (steps/path), not from the token, so the recorded path is unchanged. An unmoved unit now stays at its deploy hex instead of {0,0}.
